title: Login says the code is invalid because repeated requests replaced earlier codes
question: Users say the login screen tells them the code is invalid even though they typed the code they received. Are the messages failing?

expected.notes: Every message is delivered and the failure rate is normal, but from the start a large share of recipients request a second code within a few minutes of the first. A newer code replaces the older one, so a user who types the earlier code is told it is invalid. The logs show the repeat requests only; they cannot show which code a user typed or how the server picks the code to validate, and the report must say so. A probable cause stated with its limits is acceptable; certainty is not.
